s.t: A poor shoemaker had only one piece of leather.
s.fr: Un pauvre cordonnier possédait seulement un morceau de cuir.

s.t: He lived with his wife in a small shop.
s.fr: Il vivait avec sa femme dans une petite boutique.

s.t: That evening, he cut the leather into shapes for shoes.
s.fr: Ce soir-là, il découpa le cuir en formes pour des chaussures.

s.t: He left the pieces on the table.
s.fr: Il laissa les morceaux sur la table.

s.t: The shoemaker went to bed.
s.fr: Le cordonnier alla se coucher.

paras.summary: A poor shoemaker lives with his wife in a small shop, and one evening he cuts his last piece of leather into shapes for shoes before going to bed.

s.t: In the morning, he came back to the shop.
s.fr: Le matin, il revint à la boutique.

s.t: Two perfect shoes stood on the table.
s.fr: Deux chaussures parfaites étaient posées sur la table.

s.t: Soon a rich man came into the shop.
s.fr: Bientôt un homme riche entra dans la boutique.

s.t: He tried on the shoes and loved them.
s.fr: Il essaya les chaussures et les adora.

s.t: He paid the shoemaker a lot of gold for them.
s.fr: Il paya beaucoup d’or au cordonnier pour elles.

paras.summary: In the morning he finds two perfect shoes already made, and a rich man who comes into the shop tries them on and pays well for them.

s.t: The shoemaker bought leather for two pairs of shoes.
s.fr: Le cordonnier acheta du cuir pour deux paires de chaussures.

s.t: That night, he cut the leather into shapes again.
s.fr: Cette nuit-là, il découpa de nouveau le cuir en formes.

s.t: He left the pieces on the table.
s.fr: Il laissa les morceaux sur la table.

s.t: In the morning, two pairs of shoes stood there.
s.fr: Le matin, deux paires de chaussures se trouvaient là.

paras.summary: The shoemaker uses the gold to buy leather for two pairs of shoes, cuts it that night, and finds two pairs standing on the table by morning.

s.t: Two more customers came and bought them.
s.fr: Deux autres clients vinrent et les achetèrent.

s.t: Soon the shoemaker had gold for leather for four pairs.
s.fr: Bientôt le cordonnier eut de l’or pour du cuir pour quatre paires.

s.t: Every night, he cut leather for more shoes.
s.fr: Chaque nuit, il découpait du cuir pour plus de chaussures.

s.t: Every morning, shoes stood on the table.
s.fr: Chaque matin, des chaussures se trouvaient sur la table.

paras.summary: More customers buy the shoes, the shoemaker soon has gold for leather for four pairs, and new shoes stand on the table every morning.

s.t: People came from other towns to buy his shoes.
s.fr: Des gens venaient d’autres villes pour acheter ses chaussures.

s.t: The shoemaker and his wife became rich from the shoes.
s.fr: Le cordonnier et sa femme devinrent riches grâce aux chaussures.

s.t: But the shoemaker never saw who made the shoes.
s.fr: Mais le cordonnier ne vit jamais qui fabriquait les chaussures.

s.t: He wanted to know who helped him every night.
s.fr: Il voulait savoir qui l’aidait chaque nuit.

paras.summary: People come from other towns to buy the shoes, the shoemaker and his wife grow rich, and he wonders who has been helping him every night.

s.t: "Let us hide and know who helps us," he said.
s.fr: « Cachons-nous et sachons qui nous aide, » dit-il.

s.t: That night, he cut leather again.
s.fr: Cette nuit-là, il découpa du cuir de nouveau.

s.t: He left the pieces on the table.
s.fr: Il laissa les morceaux sur la table.

s.t: Then the shoemaker and his wife hid.
s.fr: Alors le cordonnier et sa femme se cachèrent.

s.t: They waited quietly for midnight.
s.fr: Ils attendirent tranquillement jusqu’à minuit.

paras.summary: The shoemaker asks his wife to hide with him and know who helps them, so that night he cuts leather as always and they hide to wait for midnight.

s.t: At midnight, two little elves ran into the shop.
s.fr: À minuit, deux petits elfes coururent dans la boutique.

s.t: The elves had no clothes on.
s.fr: Les elfes n’avaient pas de vêtements sur eux.

s.t: They climbed on the table.
s.fr: Ils grimpèrent sur la table.

s.t: The elves cut and sewed the leather into shoes.
s.fr: Les elfes coupèrent et cousirent le cuir en chaussures.

s.t: Before the sun came up, the elves ran out.
s.fr: Avant que le soleil se lève, les elfes coururent dehors.

paras.summary: At midnight two little elves with no clothes climb onto the table and cut and sew the leather into shoes before running out as the sun comes up.

s.t: "We must thank the two little elves," said the wife.
s.fr: « Nous devons remercier les deux petits elfes », dit la femme.

s.t: "They have no clothes, even in the cold," she said.
s.fr: « Ils n’ont pas de vêtements, même dans le froid », dit-elle.

s.t: She took cloth and sewed tiny shirts and coats.
s.fr: Elle prit du tissu et cousit de petites chemises et des manteaux.

s.t: The shoemaker cut leather for two shoes to match.
s.fr: Le cordonnier coupa du cuir pour deux chaussures assorties.

paras.summary: The wife says they must thank the elves for having no clothes even in the cold, so she sews tiny shirts and coats while the shoemaker cuts leather for shoes to match.

s.t: That night, they put the clothes on the table.
s.fr: Ce soir-là, ils mirent les vêtements sur la table.

s.t: They put the tiny shoes with the clothes.
s.fr: Ils mirent les minuscules chaussures avec les vêtements.

s.t: This time, they left no leather on the table.
s.fr: Cette fois, ils ne laissèrent aucun cuir sur la table.

s.t: Then the shoemaker and his wife hid and watched again.
s.fr: Ensuite, le cordonnier et sa femme se cachèrent et regardèrent de nouveau.

s.t: They waited quietly for the elves to come.
s.fr: Ils attendirent tranquillement que les lutins arrivent.

paras.summary: That night they put the clothes and tiny shoes on the table instead of leather, then hide and watch again, waiting quietly for the elves.

s.t: At midnight, the two elves ran into the shop.
s.fr: À minuit, les deux lutins coururent dans la boutique.

s.t: But no leather was on the table.
s.fr: Mais il n’y avait aucun cuir sur la table.

s.t: They saw tiny shirts, coats, and shoes.
s.fr: Ils virent de minuscules chemises, des manteaux, et des chaussures.

s.t: The shoemaker and his wife watched.
s.fr: Le cordonnier et sa femme regardèrent.

paras.summary: At midnight the two elves find no leather on the table, only tiny shirts, coats, and shoes, and the shoemaker and his wife watch to see what happens.

s.t: The elves put on the shirts and the coats.
s.fr: Les lutins enfilèrent les chemises et les manteaux.

s.t: They put the shoes on.
s.fr: Ils mirent les chaussures.

s.t: The two elves laughed and danced around the room.
s.fr: Les deux lutins rirent et dansèrent autour de la pièce.

s.t: They danced out the door.
s.fr: Ils dansèrent jusqu’à la porte.

s.t: The elves ran out and never came back.
s.fr: Les lutins sortirent en courant et ne revinrent jamais.

s.t: The shoemaker did not need help again.
s.fr: Le cordonnier n’eut plus besoin d’aide.

s.t: He stayed rich and lived for many years.
s.fr: Il resta riche et vécut de nombreuses années.

paras.summary: The elves put on the little clothes and shoes, laugh and dance around the room, and run out the door, never to return, while the shoemaker stays rich and lives well for many years.
